name: Exhaustive Multiple-Peak Search
definition: An automatic algorithm to detect all tissue peaks in a global histogram by iteratively finding the highest peak, fitting a Gaussian, creating a PRH for that peak's range, removing the PRH's contribution from the global histogram, and repeating until the histogram is empty.
summary: Exhaustive Multiple-Peak Search is an algorithm that detects all tissue peaks by iteratively fitting Gaussians, creating Partial Range Histograms, and subtracting them from the global histogram.
